title: A Garden for the Vow
author: Odile Ishikawa
blurb: Wendell Eastwick, a pastry chef whose café is three missed payments from gone, has spent twelve years rebuilding a life measured in small safe steps. But when the person behind a decade of letters moves in next door, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must forgive the person in the mirror first, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
